title: lithocarpus celebicus
intro: Lithocarpus celebicus, commonly known as Celebes beech, is a plant species in the beech family (Fagaceae) native to Sulawesi (Celebes) in Indonesia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus celebicus include wound healing, antidiabetic, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to exhibit potential therapeutic effects, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
